title: Emission log record v2 (anchored observation)
$comment: Structural residue of the observation.* rules (P0-2). The v2 record is what ANCHORED_OBSERVATION_ORDER commits (observation.record.commits): the exact variant, the signer/controller lifecycle state vector, and the log origin/index/checkpoint. Per the P0-4 canonical freeze the record is canonicalized with jcs-rfc8785 and log positions (index, tree size, generation) are decimal strings, not JSON numbers (canon.number.safe-integer). v1 body-only records are a distinct legacy-body observation (observation.legacy.body-only) and are not readable as v2. $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref).

observationSubject.$comment: observation.record.commits: the exact variant being observed. Exactly one of wireVariantId or evidenceViewId is the anchored subject; a body-only digest is a legacy-body observation and MUST NOT appear here.

lifecycleStateVector.$comment: observation.record.commits: the signer and controller lifecycle state at the observed position, so historical authorization can be replayed against the same states the observation saw.

logPosition.$comment: observation.record.commits / observation.order.same-origin: the log origin, index, and checkpoint that locate the record. index, treeSize, and generation are decimal strings (P0-4 canon.number.safe-integer): a log position can exceed the safe-integer range and must not be a JSON number.

membershipMethod.$comment: observation.membership.proof: how membership is proven. A filelog replay MUST NOT be reported as TLOG_INCLUSION (semantic constraint, pinned by vector).

decimalString.$comment: canon.number.safe-integer: a non-negative log position in the string domain, not a JSON number.

lifecycleState.$comment: observation.record.commits / lifecycle.event.source-of-truth: a lifecycle state entry bound to the lifecycle event/snapshot it was read from, so the state is evidence-backed rather than an asserted label. lifecycleSnapshotRef points at the durable lifecycle record (its full wire schema is a follow-up; the record freezes to jcs-rfc8785 with decimal-string positions, P0-4).
